full_page.content:
1953, October 31
The following is a faithful transcription of a typed draft by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O. F.M. Cap.
S2. FELIX FRIARY SUE TINGTOE, INDIAA
October 31st 1953.
Bles'd be God inall His designs.
Mr.Joseph Matt. Editor, The Wanderer, Saint Paul Kimmessota.
God bless you lir. Matt. God blss you and yours these hectic days - at once days of God's great mercy and of supremely tragic, international history. The great "Oracle of the eleeventh century Saint Bernard of Clarveau was wont to plead against taking scandal: "Since the scandal of the Cruci- fixion of Jusus Christ by the politically enslaved priests of the it is never reasonable to take scandal." For that was the supreme climas of all possible scandal
(Unfinished)
